svg.title: PipelineProof — architecture overview
svg.desc: A compact overview of native or Docker execution, 24 local attack exercises, the separate real kind lab, evidence and security quality gates.
svg.text: Attack paths, runtime boundaries and lab structure
Docker: non-root, read-only, no external network. Native: no sandbox. HTTP endpoints bind to loopback.
V: CI identity reads dummy Secret
S: read denied; intended patch allowed
Requires Docker + kind; not run by setup.sh.
